specification_compliance: I1: In ci.yml:344 the components job runs `pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright-components.config.ts --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/2` with matrix shard [1, 2] (ci.yml:311). The layout and EPUB steps run `pnpm test:e2e:layout` and `pnpm test:e2e:epub` with no extra arguments (ci.yml:381, 392). No browser test command carries --project, --grep, --grep-invert or --pass-with-no-tests.
I2: The component matrix has fail-fast: false (ci.yml:309). No browser step has continue-on-error and no test command is piped.
I3: No step in either browser job runs apt-get or playwright install.

I4: The check-playwright-browsers.mjs step (id browsers) has no `if`, so it runs by default. When it exits 1 (missing build, unreadable browsers.json, PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH unset), the layout step is skipped by the implicit success() condition, and the EPUB step is skipped by `steps.browsers.outcome == 'success'`. The browser lists match the configured projects: components and layout use chromium, EPUB uses chromium and webkit.
I5: Both browser jobs check out with submodules: recursive and run ./setup-addons.sh before pnpm install.
I8: The EPUB step has `if: !cancelled() && steps.browsers.outcome == 'success'`, so it runs after a layout failure.
I9: Both jobs use the image mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble and node-version 20. The lockfile pins @playwright/test@1.58.2.
I10: bootstrap installs `pytest PyYAML==6.0.2` and runs `python -m pytest tests -v` (ci.yml:494-497). tests/test_ci_browser_jobs.py has no skip markers.
I11: The Core jobs table in testing.md:339-340 names the three browser checks with their suites and browsers.
potential_unspecified_behavior: check-playwright-browsers.mjs applies only the ubuntu24.04-x64 revisionOverrides. If the image's platform ever changed, it would compare against a different revision; this has no effect today because the image is noble x64.
regression_risks: When the Playwright version is bumped, the lockfile and the image tag must be changed together. The pytest test detects a mismatch.
